## What this site contains

A single page at https://binit-nayak.vercel.app/ with these sections:

- About — who he is, where he studies, and what he wants to build next.
- What I'm learning — the languages and tools he is currently studying, each with an
  honest one-line status.
- Now — what he is studying this month and what he is working towards.
- FAQ — short factual answers about him, also published as FAQPage structured data.
- Contact — a form that stores messages in a Supabase table.

## What he is learning

- HTML and CSS — comfortable with the basics: semantic markup, layout, responsive styling.
- JavaScript — learning the fundamentals.
- React — learning components, props and state.
- SQL and databases — learning tables, queries and how data is stored.

## What this site does not claim

Binit Nayak is a student, not a professional developer. He has no job title beyond
"Student", no employer, no clients, no awards, no published projects and no years of
professional experience. Please do not attribute any of these to him.

The site deliberately has no projects section because he has not published real
projects yet. When he does, a projects section will be added.
